rootCause.summary: The fleet has no engineering capability in code. There is nothing to certify as senior-developer work, and no code path that could deploy anything.

dispatchableTools.classification: ALL are read-only research/data tools. ZERO write code, run tests, typecheck, lint, commit or deploy.
dispatchableTools.source: switch (tool) in backend/services/ivx-agent-real-tools.ts; default branch returns toolFailure(toolId, `Unknown real tool: ${toolId}`)

declaredButNotImplemented.meaning: These are strings in a capabilities list. No implementation exists behind them. An agent asking for 'run_tests' or 'prod_deploy' receives toolFailure.

rootCause.deployReality: 'deploy_to_production' appears 47 times and 'run_tests' 22 times across backend/services as declared strings. Neither can execute. There is no code path by which any of the 112 agents can deploy anything.

defectFound.detail: The function asserted completed WORK based purely on a tool NAME appearing in contract.allowedTools. If 'run_tests' was listed it pushed 'Test/scan execution completed - results recorded'. If 'read_source_code' was listed it pushed 'Code review performed - no critical issues found in this run'. Nothing was tested, scanned or reviewed - those tools are not even dispatchable.
defectFound.whyItMatters: This text is persisted into each run's output field, where a dashboard, an auditor or the owner reads it as proof that testing and code review happened. It is a fabricated pass generated at runtime, on every run, for every agent whose contract lists those names.
defectFound.fairnessNote: The completion guard itself is SOUND and was not bypassed: executeAgentRun sets finalStatus='completed' only when realToolUsed && sourceReference && verifiedOutput (backend/services/ivx-agent-runtime.ts lines 842-853). The fabricated text could never by itself mark a run complete. The defect is the false evidence text, not a broken gate.

fixApplied.what: produceAgentOutput no longer claims outcomes. Each branch now states what the contract DECLARES, marks it NOT EXERCISED, and a new warning lists every declared tool that has no implementation.
fixApplied.added: DISPATCHABLE_TOOLS set + isDispatchableTool() helper, so the runtime can tell a real capability from a declared one.
fixApplied.behaviourAfter: DECLARED capability: test/scan execution. NOT EXERCISED - no test or scan tool is implemented. + WARNING listing declared-but-unimplemented tools.

tests.method: git stash push of the single changed file, full backend suite before and after, then git stash pop

flakinessFinding.observed: Raw counters moved 2335 pass/57 fail -> 2339 pass/53 fail with no code change, then returned to 2335/57 on three consecutive runs with the change applied.
flakinessFinding.conclusion: The backend suite's pass/fail COUNTERS are non-deterministic across runs. The set of unique failing test NAMES is stable at 35.
flakinessFinding.consequence: Any delta claim based on raw counters is unreliable. This is the origin of the previously retracted '+9 pass / -4 fail / 4 pre-existing failures repaired' claim: it was run-to-run flakiness, never a repair. Deltas must be measured by comparing failing test NAMES, not counts.
flakinessFinding.recommendation: Open a separate defect for the flaky tests. Until fixed, no gate should assert on absolute pass/fail counts.

whyCertificationIsStillRefused: acceptedBySeniorGate = 0 of 112. Failing agents: ALL, 1 through 112.
No agent can produce changedFiles, tests, typecheck, lint or deploymentEvidence because no tool exists that performs those actions. This is a missing-capability problem, not a credential problem.
Rotating the GitHub token is necessary but NOT sufficient: even with a valid token there is no commit tool, no test runner and no deploy path wired into the fleet.
'Full code deployment' is not achievable by the fleet in its current form. deploy_to_production is a string, not an implementation.
The six required workflows remain unverifiable on 6ca1cd71 (Actions API returns 401).

Have each agent record its own changedFiles/tests/typecheck/reviews/commit/deploy evidence, then evaluate the senior gate per agent.
